acceptanceCriteria: A regression binds a receipt to one step and projects/plans with a second unbound, unresolvable step; the second step emits no fact.
Bound steps keep their current facts byte-for-byte.
body: Codex round-2 P3 on the issue 657/658/660 batch integration (branch claude/batch-gh657-658-660 af305d87), 2026-10-07; present already at the gh658 lane tip 0cd27805. internal/appmap/verify.go verificationOverlay.Facts (~line 450): verify checks resolution before binding, so a second step with no binding whose anchor does not resolve emits an unverified/step-unresolved learned fact. Expected (RVN-V0-006): unbound steps emit no fact and read unverified by absence. Actual: an extra fact that spends learned-fact budget.
title: appmap verification overlay emits an unverified fact for an unbound step that does not resolve
